description: This file defines the 'ProcessText' Android activity class, which handles processing text received via an intent, allowing editing and returning the processed text.

classes.name: ProcessText
classes.description: Android activity for processing and editing text received via intent, with functionality to return the result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves input text and read-only flag from intent, and configures the UI components.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Collects final edited text, puts it into the intent, and finishes the activity with a result.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Overrides menu creation, returns false indicating no menu options.
